text: もっと　たくさん　うまったら　ぜひ　わしに　みせにきてくれ！

structure.jp: もっと　たくさん　うまったら
structure.en: when a lot more has been filled in

structure.jp: ぜひ　わしに　みせにきてくれ！
structure.en: be sure to come and show me!

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before a verb of coming or going tells what you come or go to do. みせにきて = 'come in order to show'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on the end of a verb means 'when' or 'if' that thing has happened. うまったら = 'when it has been filled in'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれ is the blunt order form of てくれる, 'do it for me', used by men to people below them. きてくれ = 'come, will you'.
